title: 第9章 追杀第10章 中品炼丹房
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
离开坊市，穿过密林，二人躲进一处洞穴。
张大虎躬身缩在一旁，慢慢走动。
“你怎么知道这里的？”
“地图上这里是一条笔直的山脉，离宗门的废弃矿脉非常近，我寻思找到旧通道便可回去。”
师徒二人徒步十里终于走到一处开阔地界，上面插有沧澜宗的标旗。
“不好，他们跟来了。”
张大虎神识打开，探查到地底有金丹真人。
“这两人定是宗门弟子，不然进入到金丹真人的法阵范围不可能毫发无伤。”
张大虎从储物袋拿出阵旗开始布阵，林江月心急帮不上忙。
环顾四周，林江月神识看那矮瘦带着面具的男修穿过西边的长廊，另一个身段婀娜神情阴郁的女修紧随其后。
那两人修为不过炼气期七层，对刚筑基的张大虎而言不足为惧。
只是他们的来头值得推敲，必须活捉。
张大虎贴上两张隐匿符，静等上钩。
“吴师兄，他们躲哪去了。可别让他们跑了回去不好交差。”
“秦师姐可吩咐了，要活捉。你待会儿悠着点。”
那女修摸了摸男修胸部，妩媚轻言。
可未等他们再说，四周转起飓风将二人抛起。
接着张大虎甩出魂幡死死捆住男修，那女修见状不妙，腾空后退，拿出法器掐念法决。
“张大虎，我知道是你，有种出来单挑。”
女修接着低头扫视，一股寒气翻涌而至，对准林江月。

“一个炼气一层女修，让你尝尝我的厉害。”
张大虎转头看去，见林江月手无举措。便从石后走出，站在林江月身前，布下又一重防护阵。
“有什么冲我来！”
这时一个黑影闪过，凌空翻转，静默无声地站在那男修身后。
接着一张巨口将其吞下。
那女修大惊失色，踏壁借力，朝着洞口狂奔
张大虎面露难色：“不好！是夜影兽！”
那女修见同伴被吃，已无心与张大虎缠斗，拿出护符加持防御。又使出一招火云诀，试图驱赶妖兽。
只见那妖兽毫不畏惧，风驰电掣，一个猛扑，上去又是一口。
女修大叫一声，来不及躲闪，便被囫囵吞下。
张大虎见状拉起林江月瞬移至洞口。
只见那兽眼神犀利瞄准张、林二人，翻至头顶轻轻一跃。
张大虎巍然不惧，拿出一把长戟，直指妖兽胸间。
妖兽见状也不躲闪，呼出一口浊气隐匿身形。
张大虎将林江月推出洞口，又给她贴上隐身护符，接着大开神识探寻妖兽方位，祭出烈火符。
林江月眼看张大虎离自己越来越远，心中踌躇，进退两难。
忽的想起张大虎引她入门，又待她不薄，决心不能丢下他不管。
可成熟期的夜影兽堪比筑基后期修士，就算是张大虎竭尽全力也未必能敌，更别提一个练气一层的林江月。
这时，她转了转眼珠，呼吸也变得急促，双手在储物袋摸索。
终于她找到自己做的饭团，扔了过去！

只见那妖兽被饭团砸中，没有反应。
林江月又将全部储粮尽数倒出。
可那妖兽看都不看一眼。
content_en:
After leaving Fangshi, they walked through the dense forest and hid in a cave.
Zhang Dahu huddled aside and walked slowly.
"How do you know this place?"
"This is a straight mountain range on the map, very close to the sect's abandoned mines. I'm thinking that I can go back if I find the old passage."
The master and apprentice walked for ten miles and finally reached an open area with the Canglan Sect's flag planted on it.
"No, they're coming."
Zhang Dahu opened his spiritual consciousness and found out that there was Jindan Zhenren underground.
"These two people must be disciples of the sect, otherwise they would not be able to escape unscathed if they entered the circle of Master Jin Dan."
Zhang Dahu took out the formation flag from his storage bag and started to set up the formation. Lin Jiangyue was too anxious to help.
Looking around, Lin Jiangyue saw the short, thin male cultivator wearing a mask walking through the west corridor, followed closely by another female cultivator with a graceful figure and a gloomy expression.
Those two people were only at the seventh level of Qi refining stage, so they were not a big deal to Zhang Dahu, who had just established his foundation.
It’s just that their origins are worthy of scrutiny and they must be captured alive.
Zhang Dahu affixed two concealment charms and waited for the bait.
"Senior Brother Wu, where are they hiding? Don't let them run back and make it difficult to communicate."
"Senior Sister Qin has given orders to capture him alive. Just take it easy later."
The female cultivator touched the male cultivator's chest and spoke softly.
But before they could say anything more, a hurricane sprang up all around and threw the two of them up.
Then Zhang Dahu threw out the soul flag and tied up the male cultivator tightly. Seeing that something was not good, the female cultivator jumped back in the air, took out the magic weapon and chanted the spell.
"Zhang Dahu, I know it's you. If you have the guts, come out and challenge me."
The female cultivator then lowered her head and glanced, and a wave of cold air surged towards Lin Jiangyue.
"A female cultivator at the first level of Qi refining, let you have a taste of my power."
Zhang Dahu turned around and saw Lin Jiangyue motionless. Then he walked out from behind the stone, stood in front of Lin Jiangyue, and set up another protective formation.
"Come at me if you have anything!"
At this time, a black shadow flashed across the sky, flipped in the air, and stood silently behind the male cultivator.
Then a huge mouth swallowed it.
The female cultivator was so frightened that she stepped on the wall to use her strength and ran towards the entrance of the cave.
Zhang Dahu looked troubled: "No! It's the Night Shadow Beast!"
Seeing that her companion was being eaten, the female cultivator no longer wanted to fight with Zhang Dahu, so she took out her amulet for defense. He used the Fire Cloud Technique again to try to drive away the monster.
I saw that the monster beast was not afraid, and it pounced with lightning speed, and then took another bite.
The female cultivator screamed and was swallowed whole before she could dodge.
Upon seeing this, Zhang Dahu pulled Lin Jiangyue and teleported to the entrance of the cave.
I saw the beast's sharp eyes aimed at Zhang and Lin, then it turned to its head and jumped slightly.
Zhang Dahu was undaunted and took out a long halberd, pointing it directly at the monster's chest.
The monster didn't dodge when it saw this, and exhaled a breath of turbid air to hide its figure.
Zhang Dahu pushed Lin Jiangyue out of the cave, and put an invisibility talisman on her. Then he opened his consciousness to find the location of the monster and used the fire talisman.
Seeing Zhang Dahu getting further and further away from her, Lin Jiangyue hesitated and was in a dilemma.
Suddenly, she remembered that Zhang Dahu had introduced her to her and treated her well, so she was determined not to leave him alone.
But the mature Night Shadow Beast is comparable to the monks in the late stage of foundation building. Even if Zhang Dahu tries his best, he may not be able to defeat it, let alone Lin Jiangyue, who is at the first level of Qi training.
At this time, she rolled her eyes, her breathing became rapid, and her hands were groping in the storage bag.
Finally she found the rice balls she had made and threw them away!
I saw that the monster was hit by the rice ball and had no reaction.
Lin Jiangyue poured out all the stored grain.
But the monster didn't even look at it.
